c.title: Write to us
p.hero: Punctual and reliable, for over 30 years from Hagenow.
p.intro: {name}{plz} is about {km} km ({min} minutes' drive) from our base in Hagenow. Whether patient transport, station or airport transfer, school run or group trip: call us on 03883 723240, we will take care of it.
p.parts: We also drive to the surrounding districts and hamlets: {list}.
p.price: A ride between {name} and Hagenow costs about {preis} € according to the taxi tariff (day rate, without surcharges and waiting time). The price calculator shows the fare for your exact route.
p.t.note: Prices according to the taxi tariff (day rate, without surcharges and waiting time). Schwerin is outside our statutory service area, so we tell you the price before the ride.
p.q1: How do I order a taxi in {name}?
p.a1: Call us on {tel} or send the ride request at the top of this page. The pick-up address {name} is already filled in. We confirm by phone.
p.q2: How far is it from {name} to Hagenow?
p.a2: The driving distance between {name} and our base in Hagenow is about {km} km, the journey takes around {min} minutes.
p.q3: How much is a taxi ride from {name} to Hagenow?
p.a3: According to the taxi tariff (day rate, without surcharges and waiting time) about {preis} € for around {km} km. The price calculator shows the fare for your exact route.
p.q4: How do I get from {name} to Hagenow station?
p.a4: It is about {km} km from {name} to Hagenow Land station, the ride takes around {min} minutes and costs about {preis} € at the day rate. Feel free to book the taxi in advance on {tel}.
p.q5: Do you also drive patient transport in {name}?
p.a5: Yes, for all health insurers. It is about {km1} km ({min1} minutes) from {name} to Hagenow hospital and about {km2} km ({min2} minutes) to Helios Kliniken Schwerin. We also drive spa and rehab trips, trips to chemotherapy and radiation therapy, and transport for people with disabilities.
p.a5b: Yes, we drive patient transport for all health insurers, as well as spa and rehab trips, trips to chemotherapy and radiation therapy, and transport for people with disabilities.

pc.h1: What will my taxi ride cost?
pc.lead: Enter start and destination – we calculate the fare according to the official taxi tariff for Hagenow.
pc.consent: I agree that my addresses are sent to the map services OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) and OSRM for the calculation. See privacy policy (in German).
pc.hint: Your estimated fare will appear here.
pc.t2.p: The calculation shows what the ride will probably cost according to the tariff. It is not a booking and not a binding price quote. For rides outside the statutory service area we agree the price with you before the ride.
pc.note: The result display and the legal notes appear in German.
